# Serverless Sandbox

> Python SDK and CLI (`sbox`) for the Alibaba Cloud FC Agent Sandbox service.
> E2B-protocol compatible with Alibaba Cloud extensions (OSS, VPC, custom domains).

## Purpose

Serverless Sandbox lets AI agents and developers create, manage, and interact
with secure cloud sandboxes. It provides isolated execution environments for
running untrusted code, file operations, and shell commands — designed for
LLM tool-use and agentic workflows.

## Architecture

Six-layer architecture (lower layers never import upper layers):

- L1 Transport & Auth: HTTP/2 connection pooling, WebSocket, API Key / AK-SK auth
- L2 Core Protocol: E2B-compatible protocol (REST + WebSocket), sandbox lifecycle, filesystem, process, terminal, port
- L3 Extensions: Alibaba Cloud ecosystem — OSS mounts, VPC networking, custom domains
- L4 High-Level API: Sandbox class, SandboxPool, file ops, code execution, network helpers
- L5 Declarative API: @sandbox decorator for automatic remote execution with serialisation
- L6 Agent Integration: MCP tool server, built-in agent harnesses, framework adapters

## Key APIs

### SDK (Python, async-first)

```python
from serverless_sandbox import Sandbox

async with await Sandbox.create(template="python-base") as sb:
    result = await sb.run_code("print('hello')")     # code execution
    await sb.filesystem.write("/tmp/f.txt", b"data")  # file I/O
    proc = await sb.commands.run("ls /tmp")            # shell command
```

### CLI

```
sbox create --template python-base   # create sandbox
sbox exec <id> "echo hello"          # run command
sbox upload <id> ./local /remote     # file transfer
sbox mcp serve                       # start MCP server
sbox kill <id>                       # destroy sandbox
```

## Source Layout

- src/serverless_sandbox/transport/ — HTTP, WebSocket, auth, codec
- src/serverless_sandbox/protocol/ — sandbox lifecycle, filesystem, process, terminal
- src/serverless_sandbox/models/ — Pydantic data models, error hierarchy
- src/serverless_sandbox/api/ — Sandbox class, file/code/command/network/pool APIs
- src/serverless_sandbox/cli/ — Click-based CLI commands and formatters
- src/serverless_sandbox/agent/ — MCP server, built-in agents, tool definitions
- src/serverless_sandbox/compat/ — E2B drop-in compatibility layer
- src/serverless_sandbox/declarative/ — @sandbox decorator
- src/serverless_sandbox/extensions/ — OSS, VPC, domain extensions
- src/serverless_sandbox/integrations/ — LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen adapters
